quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks' ultimatum regarding Giannis Antetokounmpo's future
quotes.excerpt: by the draft, they're either going to have traded Giannis or they're going to be then deciding to build around Giannis.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: We're operating under the belief that the Bucks are going to seriously, this may be it.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: That the draft is a trade deadline. Jimmy Haslam, the owner, one of the owners of the Bucks, said it very plainly, that by the draft, they're either going to have traded Giannis or they're going to be then deciding to build around Giannis. It's like A or B.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami Heat's aggressive pursuit of Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: The Miami Heat badly want Giannis Antetokounmpo.
quotes.quote: One we know about for sure is Miami. The Miami Heat badly want Giannis Antetokounmpo. The Bucks want a package of established talent, prospects, and draft picks. Now, the Heat can offer that. Whether they can be beats another, you got to max the salary. You're not trading Bam Adebayo.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro's role in potential trade packages
quotes.excerpt: So Tyler Herro, who is in an extension situation. I'm not sure the Heat are in the mood to extend Herro.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: So Tyler Herro, who is in an extension situation. I'm not sure the Heat are in the mood to extend Herro. They weren't in the mood to extend Jimmy Butler two years ago, so I'm not sure they're in the mood to extend Herro.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I think they'd rather extend Giannis than Herro.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaime Jaquez Jr. and Kel'el Ware as trade assets
quotes.excerpt: There'd be quite a few teams that would be interested in Kel'el Ware if he got shipped in Milwaukee.
quotes.quote: Then you have a selection of young prospects led by Jaime Jaquez Jr. Kel'el Ware, who's dynamic, first-round draft pick two years ago, big man who can stretch the floor, high energy, block shots. Frankly, there'd be quite a few teams that would be interested in Kel'el Ware if he got shipped in Milwaukee and they were willing to flip him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating Miami's trade package versus other potential offers
quotes.excerpt: I would say that if Giannis winds up on the Heat, it's for one of two reasons.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I would say that if Giannis winds up on the Heat, it's for one of two reasons. It's either because he puts his thumb on the scale and says, 'I'm only going to play for the Heat,' which frankly to this point, Giannis has shown no sign to do any of that ever with any of this stuff, and so I would not anticipate that happening. And the other part is if teams are just wary of outbidding Miami.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: If the teams that have been discussed decide to get in the mix, I think they all have enough to outbid the Heat if they choose to actually say, 'We want to go down the road with Giannis.'

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing asset value of Evan Mobley versus Miami's package
quotes.excerpt: Evan Mobley is more valuable than any of the stuff that Miami's giving up.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Evan Mobley is more valuable than any of the stuff that Miami's giving up. Pau Gasol is more valuable than any of the stuff Miami is giving up.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Perhaps Orlando looks at it and says, 'We'd rather have Pau Gasol. We don't want to trade for Giannis.' But if Orlando gets in the mix and says, 'We want to make a trade for Giannis,' they're going to outbid Miami.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: John Hammond's connection to Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: There are some connections to Orlando with Giannis. John Hammond is in the front office there.
quotes.quote: There are some connections to Orlando with Giannis. John Hammond is in the front office there. He drafted Giannis in Milwaukee.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Doc Rivers to Michael Malone
quotes.excerpt: He's sort of cut from the same cloth as another guy who got his first head coaching job.
quotes.quote: He's sort of cut from the same cloth as another guy who got his first head coaching job about his age, which is Michael Malone. Similar backgrounds where they were very successful assistants who are fiery and know how to coach.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Koby Altman's commitment to the Cavaliers' core
quotes.excerpt: He gave a valentine to Evan Mobley, gave a valentine to Jared Allen, gave a valentine to James Harden.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Koby Altman, their team president, came out after the season and said on the record basically, he didn't say we're running it back, but he gave a valentine to Evan Mobley, gave a valentine to Jared Allen, gave a valentine to James Harden. Obviously, they hope to extend Donovan Mitchell.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: He poured cold water on the possibility of blowing it up.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Dan Gilbert's stance on the Cavaliers' competitiveness
quotes.excerpt: If I was a Cavs executive and I was watching how physical this finals was, I'm not certain.
quotes.quote: If I was a Cavs executive and I was watching how physical this finals was, I'm not certain my team would do very well.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: There's one other lever to pull, which is turning Evan Mobley into a big upgrade.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: If the Cavs are, as we've talked, resigning James Harden, which we think they're going to, and extending Donovan Mitchell, or having some agreement with them to extend in a year, which we think they're going to, and they're keeping Kenny Atkinson as the coach, which they're going to, there's one other lever to pull, which is turning Evan Mobley into a big upgrade.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I'm just saying that what Koby Altman said, and I have not heard that the Cavs are offering anything. I'm not saying they are either, but that's where I go back to the Miami thing.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's trade value for Boston
quotes.excerpt: Boston, you're basically talking about Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: Boston, you're basically talking about Jaylen Brown. Let me ask you this, Jaylen Brown or Pau Gasol, who would you rather take to build around? I'd go, I'd go Gasol simply because he's younger and less expensive.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of pick-based trades for teams like Golden State
quotes.excerpt: I'm not sure that a pick-based trade is... You're looking at like Jimmy Butler or Draymond Green.
quotes.quote: I'm not sure that a pick-based trade is... You're looking at like Jimmy Butler or Draymond Green and picks. And Jimmy Butler doesn't have immediate value. He's out. And Draymond Green, like he can't, I don't even, I mean, I, I, I think that's a pick-based trade that has no place.
